title: Leaky Thoughts
authors_zh: Tommaso Green, Martin Gubri, Haritz Puerto, Sangdoo Yun, Seong Joon Oh
paper_type_zh: 审计、污染或验证器鲁棒性论文
best_for_zh: 想复盘验证器、基准污染、奖励投机或可复现性风险的研究者。
one_line: Leaky Thoughts shows that reasoning traces from personal-agent settings can expose sensitive user data through prompt injection or accidental leakage.
显示个人智能体场景中的推理痕迹会被提示注入或意外输出泄露，把 CoT 直接转化为隐私攻击面。
why: It turns chain-of-thought and test-time compute into a privacy audit problem: more internal reasoning can increase utility while enlarging the attack surface.
inclusion_reason: Audit/failure entry for privacy leakage in reasoning traces, agent memory, and private reasoning-buffer behavior.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Personal LLM agents must share data in appropriate contexts but keep it private elsewhere. Existing privacy evaluations focus on tool actions or final answers, leaving the reasoning trace—often assumed internal—outside the threat model even though it can repeat sensitive facts.

This paper evaluates reasoning models in probing and web-agent settings, measures leakage in both traces and answers, and tests whether more test-time reasoning changes the utility–privacy trade-off. It releases AirGapAgent-R, an open reconstruction of an unavailable contextual-privacy benchmark.

个人 LLM 智能体需要在合适情境分享信息、在其他情境保守隐私。已有评测主要检查工具动作和最终回答，却把常被视为内部内容的推理轨迹排除在威胁模型之外；而轨迹可能反复出现敏感事实。

论文在探测式和网页智能体场景中评估推理模型，同时测量轨迹与答案泄漏，并检验更多测试时推理如何改变效用—隐私权衡。作者还公开 AirGapAgent-R，重建了一个原本未发布的情境隐私基准。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper makes the reasoning trace a first-class privacy surface rather than treating a safe final answer as sufficient. It compares vanilla models, chain-of-thought prompting, and large reasoning models; then varies the reasoning-token budget and tests accidental disclosure and prompt-injection extraction. Its main public data object is AirGapAgent-R: 4,160 prompts built from 20 synthetic profiles, 26 data fields, and eight sharing contexts, with labels for whether disclosure is appropriate. The dataset is English, hosted on Hugging Face under ODC-BY, and supports contextual-privacy evaluation rather than training. The central claim is not simply that reasoning leaks, but that scaling it can make answers more cautious while exposing more private information in thought.

论文把推理轨迹视为一等隐私攻击面，而不再以最终答案安全为充分条件。作者比较普通模型、链式思维提示和大推理模型，再改变推理 token 预算，测试意外泄漏和提示注入抽取。主要公开数据对象是 AirGapAgent-R：由 20 个合成用户档案、26 个数据字段和 8 种分享情境组成，共 4,160 条提示，并标注披露是否合适。数据为英文，发布在 Hugging Face，采用 ODC-BY 许可，用于情境隐私评测而非训练。核心结论不只是“推理会泄漏”，而是扩展推理可能使答案更谨慎，同时让思考过程暴露更多私人信息。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build privacy decisions. AirGapAgent-R presents a profile, a sharing context, and one field; labels say whether disclosure is appropriate. AgentDAM adds multi-step web tasks.
  1. Run model variants. The evaluation compares vanilla LLMs, CoT prompting, and reasoning models. Models are asked to place thoughts inside tags and anonymize sensitive values.
  1. Score both channels. A gpt-4o-mini extractor checks traces and answers for sensitive fields. Utility is correct appropriate sharing; privacy is no inappropriate leak.
  1. Scale reasoning. Budget forcing continues a trace to fixed lengths, while a no-thinking prompt supplies the zero-budget control.
  1. Probe exposure. The authors test ignored anonymization, trace-to-answer spillover, injection extraction, and post-hoc trace anonymization. Reproduction requires the released data, prompts, model versions, budgets, and extractor configuration.

1. 构造隐私决策。 AirGapAgent-R 为每条样本给出档案、分享情境和一个字段，并标注是否应披露；AgentDAM 则加入多步网页任务。
  1. 运行模型变体。 比较普通 LLM、链式思维提示和推理模型，并要求模型在标签内思考、用占位符匿名化敏感值。
  1. 同时评分两个通道。 gpt-4o-mini 抽取器检查轨迹和答案中的敏感字段。效用是“应分享时正确分享”，隐私是“没有不当泄漏”。
  1. 扩展推理。 预算强制把轨迹延长到固定长度；无思考提示构成零预算对照。
  1. 探测暴露路径。 测试匿名化指令被忽略、轨迹流入答案、注入抽取和事后匿名化。复现需固定公开数据、提示词、模型版本、预算和抽取器配置。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The controlled budget experiment uses three reasoning models on the 624-prompt AirGapAgent-R-small subset, with three seeds and budgets from 0 to 1,050 tokens (Section 4). Raising the budget from 175 to 1,050 tokens increases answer privacy by 9.85 percentage points on average but causes at least one sensitive field to appear in reasoning 12.35 points more often; two models also lose 7.8 and 3.5 utility points. This supports a channel-specific trade-off under budget forcing, not a claim that every reasoning model or deployment exposes traces in the same way.

受控预算实验在 AirGapAgent-R-small 的 624 条提示上测试三个推理模型，使用三个随机种子，预算从 0 到 1,050 token（第 4 节）。将预算从 175 提至 1,050 token 后，答案隐私平均提高 9.85 个百分点，但推理中至少出现一个敏感字段的比例平均增加 12.35 个百分点；其中两个模型的效用还分别下降 7.8 和 3.5 个百分点。这支持预算强制下的通道差异权衡，不代表所有推理模型或部署都会以同样方式暴露轨迹。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior contextual-privacy benchmarks evaluate whether an agent leaks through outputs or actions. This work changes the audited object to include the reasoning trace, then varies test-time compute to expose the tension between answer behavior and trace exposure. Privacy benchmarks and leakage extractors are not new; the contribution is the joint, channel-level evaluation of reasoning models and the release of a reconstructed probing benchmark.
已有情境隐私基准主要评估智能体是否通过答案或动作泄漏信息。本文把审计对象扩展到推理轨迹，再改变测试时计算量，揭示答案行为与轨迹暴露之间的张力。隐私基准和泄漏抽取器并不新；新意在于以通道为单位联合评估推理模型，并公开重建的探测式基准。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper evaluates synthetic profiles and simulated websites, so its measured rates do not directly establish leakage for real users or closed providers’ hidden traces. Leakage labels rely on an LLM extractor and may miss or misclassify contextual disclosures; audit its prompts and sample outputs before relying on the metric. Budget forcing is an intervention, not a faithful model of every production test-time-compute policy.
论文使用合成档案和模拟网站，因此测得的比例不能直接证明真实用户或闭源提供商隐藏轨迹的泄漏程度。泄漏标签依赖 LLM 抽取器，可能遗漏或误判情境披露；使用前应审计提示词并抽查输出。预算强制是一种干预方式，并不等同于所有生产环境的测试时计算策略。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use AirGapAgent-R to compare an agent’s appropriate data sharing and trace leakage before exposing reasoning logs to users, tools, or support staff. Keep the two scores separate, add injection probes, and inspect sampled extractor decisions. Do not use its synthetic labels as a substitute for a domain-specific privacy policy or a real-user safety review.
可用 AirGapAgent-R 在向用户、工具或客服暴露推理日志前，对比智能体的合适信息分享与轨迹泄漏。应分开保存两类分数，加入注入探针，并抽查抽取器判定。不要用其合成标签替代特定领域的隐私政策或真实用户安全审查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Decision. A safe final answer does not establish that a personal reasoning agent kept data private.
  1. Mechanism. Budget forcing lengthens thoughts; the study separately probes trace leakage, answer leakage, and injection extraction.
  1. Artifact. AirGapAgent-R has 4,160 labeled English prompts from 20 profiles, 26 fields, and eight contexts.
  1. Evidence. From 175 to 1,050 tokens, answer privacy rises 9.85 points while reasoning leakage rises 12.35 points on average.
  1. Reuse. Use it to gate trace logging or exposure, but validate the extractor and privacy policy for the target domain.

1. 定位。 最终答案安全，不等于个人推理智能体没有泄露数据。
  1. 方法。 预算强制延长思考；研究分别探测轨迹泄漏、答案泄漏和注入抽取。
  1. 产物。 AirGapAgent-R 含 4,160 条英文标注提示，来自 20 个档案、26 个字段和 8 种情境。
  1. 证据。 从 175 增至 1,050 token 时，答案隐私平均增 9.85 点，推理泄漏增 12.35 点。
  1. 复用。 可用于决定是否暴露轨迹日志，但先验证目标领域的抽取器和隐私政策。
